# Rise and Battle the Day

## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13

## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church was not a suggestion—it was a battle cry. Notice the verbs: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. Every one of them demands action. Faith is not passive. It is not something you merely hold; it is something you contend for. The enemy does not take days off, and neither can we. But here is the key: our strength is not self-generated. The same verse sits in a letter saturated with grace. We stand firm *in the faith*, not in our own grit. We act like men because we have been adopted as sons. We are strong because the God of the universe fuels us. So today, do not drift. Do not coast. Set your watch, plant your feet, and step into the fight with your chest out and your knees bent in prayer. The battle is real, but the victory is already won.

## Daily Challenge
Do 25 pushups, and with each rep thank God for the strength He supplies—not the strength you manufacture. Then stand firm today in one area where you've been tempted to drift.
